phase: Before any execution of the separately composed current-base source; original VNDB full-host results still pending. Existing old-base JMdict/Jitendex full cells are inconclusive.
fullProductCommit: Freeze exact six-file product after independent compiled-artifact/correctness audit; before any new full-browser acquisition
target: VNDB; JMdict is the priority non-regression corpus, with Jitendex also required

performanceReviewThreshold.interval: Descriptive paired 95% interval below zero on each independent host
performanceReviewThreshold.controls: Candidate effect must be meaningfully larger than identical-code control variation; never subtract controls
performanceReviewThreshold.nonTargetPolicy: Hold if either non-target corpus shows a replicated material regression. A slowdown of at least 1% on both hosts, at least 9/12 slower pairs on each, intervals above zero and controls materially smaller is a predeclared rejection condition. Inconclusive or discordant evidence must be reported and does not prove non-regression.
performanceReviewThreshold.scope: File input through completion of required post-UI work; fresh profiles, production defaults, uninstrumented timing

requiredGates.correctness: Exact source reproduction, focused regression suite, full unit/options suites, strict main/test types, lint, dry builds, full browser inventory/restart/canonical lookup/media validation
requiredGates.storage: Unchanged complete validation receipts and exact corpus storage totals under the existing observer
requiredGates.memory: Unchanged a7f7 prospective coverage and process-tree memory screens on both independent hosts; no new parser heap reservation
requiredGates.package: Only js/dictionary/wasm/term-bank-parser.c and lib/term-bank-parser.wasm may differ in the release package; record exact compressed/uncompressed size changes and source-bound binary hashes for review

failurePolicy: Preserve all observations and failed gates. Component or profiler gains cannot substitute for full-import qualification. No performance PR if the completed evidence does not justify review.

composition.scope: Original numeric suffix design composed with merged #972. Only successful suffix reuse adds bounded current score/non-null sequence span recovery for existing token-end outputs. No admission, cache, threshold, flags or persisted format changes.
composition.currentPreparationScope: One separately source-bound build and correctness run only; not performance qualification.
